system.description:
At 20th level, your renown is unparalleled, your presence portends violence and doom, and your foes tremble before your armies. You gain the following benefits.

  • Loyalty. You gain the service of 4 squads of @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-monsters.Actor.t7raw64ksqor1nt0]{Knights} and a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-monsters.Actor.jevoqkjtgdtt4bvt]{Knight Captain} who serve you directly or as a unit in mass combat.

  • Passion. When you attempt to convince an enemy to surrender on the battlefield, you may use any one of your attribute modifiers on your skill checks to accomplish that goal.
